verdict.rationale: Railway's docs say you can "develop locally and deploy from your terminal with the Railway CLI", and a probe confirms official CLI documentation exists at docs.railway.com/guides/cli. The setup docs also cover installing the CLI and handling authentication in one command, so the core story is clearly supported. Missing for 10: specific deploy commands and workflow detail (such as project creation, linking and environment selection all done from the CLI), confirmation that no dashboard step is ever needed, and independent or hands-on proof of CLI deploys.
